chunks: And in the narration of Hisham ibn Salim, from him, peace be upon him, he said:
Lentils, chickpeas, and other than that.

key_terms.غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ: other similar things beyond those mentioned
key_terms.هِشَامِ: Hisham, the named transmitter in the report
